column2: ENGLISH
The Treasury of Ba Sing Se
Open the treasury of Ba Sing Se: its income, the works, and what the crown can do with its gold and authority.
Build the Royal Roads
Pave the old roads between the cities of the Earth Kingdom. 100 gold to begin, then 4 yearly stages of 125.

When finished, every Earth Kingdom province outside the Si Wong Desert gets supply +1 and tax +5%, and the crown can rule 15 more provinces directly before it is overextended. The roads serve invaders as well.
A Single Law for the Kingdom
Write one law for every state that answers to Ba Sing Se. Needs the States or Monarchism unity law. 200 gold to begin, then 3 yearly stages of 200.

When finished: Royal Authority +5, tributaries break away half as often, the treasury's share of tribute grows by 25%, every Earth Kingdom tributary thinks 10 less of the crown for 20 years, and the crown can rule 15 more provinces directly before it is overextended.
Fill the Royal Granaries
Build granaries across the Ba Sing Se region. 100 gold to begin, then 2 yearly stages of 100.
When finished, every province of the Ba Sing Se region gets tax +10% and disease defence +20%.
Draw on the Treasury
Move gold from the treasury of Ba Sing Se into your own purse. Half of it is lost on the way, and the court will talk.
Treasury -100, your gold +50, Royal Authority -5.
Sabotage the Crown's Works
Pay agents to slow down Ba Sing Se's works. They may succeed, achieve nothing, or be caught.
Costs 25 gold. About half the time a running work loses a year. If your agents are caught, you lose 50 prestige and the Earth King learns who sent them.
You sabotaged the crown's works less than five years ago.
Royal Roads: stage [global_atxb_w_roads_stage.GetValue] of 4 next.
A Single Law for the Kingdom: stage [global_atxb_w_law_stage.GetValue] of 3 next.
Royal Granaries: stage [global_atxb_w_granaries_stage.GetValue] of 2 next.
The Royal Roads are finished.
A Single Law for the Kingdom is in force.
The Royal Granaries are full.
Royal Road
A paved royal road runs through this province.
Royal Granaries
The crown's granaries keep this province fed through hard years.
One Law Imposed
Sabotaged the Crown's Works
The treasury of Ba Sing Se is ours. Whatever the Earth Kings saved for their roads and granaries now fills our coffers.
To the victor.

The treasury of Ba Sing Se holds [global_atxb_treasury.GetValue] gold.

Last year the crown lands paid in [global_atxb_last_crown.GetValue] gold, and [global_atxb_last_skim.GetValue] gold came from the tribute of [global_atxb_tribs.GetValue] Earth Kingdom tributaries, [global_atxb_unlinked.GetValue] of them out of the crown's reach (no chain of loyal realms to Ba Sing Se). The treasury takes at most 80 gold a year, never more than a quarter of the king's own purse, and nothing while the king has less than 25 gold.

Royal Authority stands at [global_royalAuthority.GetValue]. To order two warring Earth realms to make peace, open the attacker's diplomacy screen (Royal Arbitration).

The treasury of Ba Sing Se holds [global_atxb_treasury.GetValue] gold, but it is not yours to spend. The Grand Secretariat decides what is built, and what is taken.\n\nLast year the crown lands paid in [global_atxb_last_crown.GetValue] gold, and [global_atxb_last_skim.GetValue] gold came from the tribute of [global_atxb_tribs.GetValue] tributaries. Royal Authority stands at [global_royalAuthority.GetValue].
Check possible works...
Draw on the Treasury (treasury -100, your gold +50, Royal Authority -5)
Call a corvée (Royal Authority -15, treasury +100)
Close the ledgers.
Of course.
Another stretch of the Royal Roads is finished. Masons and earthbenders move on to the next.
The ministers report progress on the Single Law. Another set of provincial customs has been written into the code.
The first granaries stand filled. The rest are being raised.
Good.
The treasury could not pay for this year's work on the Royal Roads. The crews wait.
The treasury could not pay for this year's work on the Single Law. The ministers wait.
The treasury could not pay for this year's work on the granaries. The builders wait.
Three years without pay. The work on the Royal Roads has been abandoned, and what was spent is lost.
Three years without pay. The Single Law has been abandoned, and what was spent is lost.
Three years without pay. The granaries have been abandoned, and what was spent is lost.
Unfortunate.
The Royal Roads are finished. Merchants, messengers and soldiers move between the cities of the Earth Kingdom faster than ever before. So, of course, could an enemy.
A Single Law for the Kingdom is in force. From the northern mountains to the southern islands, every state that answers to Ba Sing Se answers to the same code. Not all of them are pleased.
The Royal Granaries are full. The Ba Sing Se region will not starve in a bad year.
A work worthy of the crown.
Ba Sing Se has finished its Single Law for the Kingdom. Our courts must now follow the crown's code instead of our own customs.
We will remember this.
Our agents did their work. One of the crown's projects has lost a year.
Our agents reached the works but found nothing they could damage without being seen. The gold is gone.
Our agents were caught, and they talked. The Earth King knows who sent them.
So be it.
Agents caught at the crown's works have confessed. They were sent by [From.GetTitledName].
This will not be forgotten.
Ba Sing Se Came to Our Aid
Ba Sing Se Spared Nothing for Us
A Token Host from Ba Sing Se
Ba Sing Se Turned Us Away
A memorandum from the Grand Secretariat informs Your Majesty that work has begun on the Royal Granaries, so that the Lower Ring may be fed. Your Majesty need not trouble yourself with the details.
The ledgers show that [global_atxb_sec_take.GetValue] gold left the royal treasury this year for expenses of state. No further explanation was given.

A memorandum from the Grand Secretariat informs Your Majesty that work has begun on the Royal Granaries. The ledgers also show that [global_atxb_sec_take.GetValue] gold left the treasury for expenses of state. No further explanation was given.
Plea to Ba Sing Se

Our realm is under attack. Send an envoy to Ba Sing Se and ask the Earth King for gold and soldiers. How much the crown can send depends on its authority, and the crown may refuse. Once every five years.
The Earth King will answer. Under a puppet king, the Grand Secretariat answers instead.

An envoy from [From.GetTitledName] has come to Ba Sing Se. Their realm is under attack, and they ask the crown for help.

The treasury holds [global_atxb_treasury.GetValue] gold, and Royal Authority stands at [global_royalAuthority.GetValue]. The stronger the crown, the more it can send: below 30 authority, 25 gold or 300 men. From 30, 40 gold or 600 men. From 60, 60 gold or 1,000 men. The men are raised at their capital, cost them nothing and go home at peace. Whatever the treasury cannot cover comes from your own purse.

Helping raises your authority. Refusing lowers it, and if they are a tributary, they will remember.
Send them gold.
Raise a host at their capital.
Send gold and raise a host.
Refuse them.
Ba Sing Se has answered our plea. The Earth King has sent gold to pay for our defence.
Ba Sing Se has answered our plea. On the Earth King's orders, a host has been raised at our capital to fight beside us until the war is over.
Ba Sing Se has answered our plea with gold and a host raised at our capital. The Earth King has not forgotten us.
Ba Sing Se has refused our plea. We stand alone.
Our envoy never saw the Earth King. An official of the Grand Secretariat received him, and a small host was raised at our capital. It is less than we asked for.
Our envoy never saw the Earth King. An official of the Grand Secretariat told him that the king does not concern himself with such matters, and sent him home.
So be it.

A memorandum from the Grand Secretariat: an envoy from [From.GetTitledName] came to the palace asking for help in a war. The Secretariat sent a small host on Your Majesty's behalf. Your Majesty need not trouble yourself with the details.

A memorandum from the Grand Secretariat: an envoy from [From.GetTitledName] came to the palace with petty complaints about a war. The Secretariat sent him home. Your Majesty need not trouble yourself with the details.
I see.
Overextended Crown
Ba Sing Se rules more of the Earth Kingdom directly than its officials can govern.
Ba Sing Se rules more of the Earth Kingdom directly than its officials can govern.
Badly Overextended Crown
Ba Sing Se rules far more of the Earth Kingdom directly than its officials can govern. Distant lords ignore the crown's orders.
Ba Sing Se rules far more of the Earth Kingdom directly than its officials can govern. Distant lords ignore the crown's orders.

Provinces ruled directly outside the walls of Ba Sing Se: [global_atxb_outside.GetValue]. The crown is overextended from [global_atxb_cap1.GetValue] and badly overextended from [global_atxb_cap2.GetValue]. The Royal Roads and A Single Law each raise both by 15.
The crown is overextended: vassal opinion -10, tax -15%, revolt risk +2%.
The crown is badly overextended: vassal opinion -20, tax -25%, revolt risk +4%.
Under Monarchism, with the Royal Roads and A Single Law in place, the crown can rule the whole Earth Kingdom directly. It is never overextended.

The treasury holds [global_atxb_treasury.GetValue] gold. A work takes its first payment when it starts and one stage a year after that. Only the works the treasury can afford now are offered below.

Royal Roads: 100, then 4 stages of 125.
A Single Law for the Kingdom: 200, then 3 stages of 200. Needs the States or Monarchism unity law.
Royal Granaries: 100, then 2 stages of 100.
Build the Royal Roads (100, then 4 stages of 125)
A Single Law for the Kingdom (200, then 3 stages of 200)
Fill the Royal Granaries (100, then 2 stages of 100)
Back to the treasury
Call a Corvée
Summon the people of the Earth Kingdom to labour on the crown's works. It costs the crown authority, but saves its gold.
Royal Authority -15, treasury +100. Only while a work is under construction, once a year.
Royal Arbitration
As Earth King, order this realm to end its war against a fellow Earth realm. Earth realms that defy the crown cost it face.
You have not arbitrated a war in the last year
Royal Authority of at least 10
Royal Authority of at least 15
Royal Authority of at least 25
Royal Authority -10
Royal Authority -15
Royal Authority -25

If they obey, every war they wage against a fellow Earth realm ends in a white peace, and they may not declare war for 2 years. If they defy you, the crown loses another 5 Royal Authority and you lose 25 prestige. A strong crown, a loyal tributary and good opinion make obedience likelier.
The Earth King loses 5 Royal Authority and 25 prestige.

An envoy of Earth [atxb_arbiter.GetKingQueen] [atxb_arbiter.GetFirstName] has arrived with a royal command: our war against our fellow Earth realm must end. Ba Sing Se will not watch the Earth Kingdom bleed itself while its enemies gather.
We will obey the Earth [atxb_arbiter.GetKingQueen].
Ba Sing Se has no say in this.
[atxb_arb_target.GetTitledName] has obeyed your command and made peace. The Earth Kingdom will remember who ended the war.
[atxb_arb_target.GetTitledName] has sent your envoy home. Your command was ignored, and the whole court knows it.
So be it.
Forced to make peace
Petition for a Royal Grant
Ask the Earth King for gold from the treasury of Ba Sing Se. A generous king earns loyalty, and a refusal is remembered.
The treasury of Ba Sing Se holds at least 50 gold
The Earth King may grant 100 gold, grant 50, or refuse. Once every 5 years.
Treasury -100. They receive 100 gold, think 25 better of you for 10 years, and won't break away for 10 years.
Treasury -50. They receive 50 gold and think 15 better of you for 10 years.

An envoy from [From.GetTitledName] has come to the palace. [From.GetFirstName] asks the crown for a grant from the treasury of Ba Sing Se, to set the realm's affairs in order.\n\nThe treasury holds [global_atxb_treasury.GetValue] gold.
Grant 100 gold
Grant 50 gold
The treasury has other uses.
The Earth King has answered our petition generously: 100 gold from the treasury of Ba Sing Se.
The Earth King has answered our petition with 50 gold from the treasury of Ba Sing Se.
The Earth King has refused our petition. The treasury of Ba Sing Se, we are told, has other uses.
Our envoy never saw the Earth King. An official of the Grand Secretariat told him that the treasury is fully committed, and sent him home.
So be it.
Granted gold by Ba Sing Se
Granted much gold by Ba Sing Se
Refused a royal grant

Daofei have been seen in [atxb_daofei_prov.GetName]. The outlaw brotherhoods rob travellers on the roads, sell protection to the markets, and answer to no one but their own sworn elders. They grow bolder whenever Ba Sing Se looks weak.\n\nWe can send soldiers after them, come to a quiet understanding, or, while we are at war, put their swords to use.
Root them out (25 gold).
A quiet understanding: they keep to themselves, and pay for the privilege.
Hire them (25 gold): 500 irregulars until the war ends.
Daofei
Outlaw brotherhoods operate here: they skim the markets and stir up trouble.
Outlaw brotherhoods operate here: they skim the markets and stir up trouble.
Hire Daofei Irregulars
Buy the swords of the outlaw brotherhoods for this war. They fight cheaply and leave when the war is over, but they don't leave the land entirely.
500 irregulars (light infantry and archers) at your capital until the war ends. If no daofei operate in your realm yet, they settle at your capital for 5 years (tax -15%, revolt risk +2%).
You have not hired daofei in the last 3 years
